errors.evidence: In the Test2 group, the bars for d-vector and s-vector are of equal height, corresponding to a value of 17.5%. The description provides incorrect values (17.3% and 17.4%) and incorrectly implies that the s-vector value is higher than the d-vector value.
In the Test3 group, the bar for s-vector aligns exactly with the 16% grid line. The reported value of 16.2% is an overestimation.

In the Test4 group, the bars for i-vector and d-vector are of equal height, corresponding to a value of 16.0%. The description provides incorrect values (16.2% and 16.3%) and incorrectly implies a difference in their values.
In the Test5 group, the bar for s-vector is visibly below the 15% grid line, at approximately 14.8%. The reported value of 15.0% is inaccurate.
